description: This Java interface defines a provider for determining entity tags (ETags) for entities involved in command processing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods to derive previous and next entity tags based on commands and entities, and a default method to conditionally add ETag headers to responses.

classes.name: ETagEntityProvider
classes.description: A generic interface for providers that determine EntityTags for commands and entities, used in ETag generation and validation.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an Optional EntityTag representing the previous state of the entity before a command is applied, possibly null.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an Optional EntityTag representing the next state of the entity after a command, possibly null.

methods.name: appendETagHeaderIfProvided
methods.description: Appends an ETag header to the response if an EntityTag is provided by the entity.
